title: Match: deny-merge list
description: Pairs that must never merge even if match/group.ts's auto tiers would — the counterpart to match-force.json. Deliberately pairwise, not destination+sources: there's no canonical side to a "keep these apart" rule.

reason.description: Why these look like the same app but genuinely aren't — required so the exception is auditable later, not just an unexplained line.
